altitude.puno: Puno sits at 3,800 m (12,500 ft): take your first hours slowly, stay hydrated and avoid heavy meals to prevent altitude sickness (soroche).
altitude.cusco: Cusco sits at 3,400 m (11,150 ft): rest on your arrival day, stay hydrated and check with your doctor if you have a heart or respiratory condition.
